typography.guidelines: Maintain existing fonts but enforce tracking-tight for headers. Ensure system translation text matches original weight and size. DO NOT translate metadata (Artist Name, Song Title, etc).

visual enhancers.chat_toast: bottom-24 right-6 to avoid chat FAB overlap. Use subtle slide-in-from-right animation.
visual enhancers.sidebar_button: absolute -right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-border bg-background shadow-sm hover:scale-110 transition-transform

layouts.header_actions: flex items-center justify-end gap-3 lg:gap-4 ml-auto
layouts.bottom_audio_player: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 w-full h-24 px-6 md:px-12 flex items-center justify-between z-50
layouts.role_preview: border border-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6 bg-muted/20 overflow-hidden relative shadow-inner

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. L10N/Translations: Move Language toggle to Header (top right, next to bell). Implement global translation for system text ONLY. Exclude Label Name, Artist, Song Title, and Release metadata from translation.

2. Theme Toggle & Branding: Add 3-state toggle (Light/Dark/Auto) to Header. Auto mode relies on Asia/Jakarta timezone (WIB): Light between 06:00-17:59, Dark between 18:00-05:59. Update `Brand.jsx` to reflect theme: Light mode uses `logo-mono.png`, Dark mode uses `logo-mark.png`.

3. Sidebar Enhancements: Position the collapse toggle button exactly on the middle of the right divider border (`absolute -right-3 top-1/2`). Use a simple, clean `ChevronLeft`/`ChevronRight` icon. If sidebar is collapsed, swap logo to `logo-icon-gradient.png` (light) or `logo-icon-outline.png` (dark).
4. Chat Notifications: Render the 'Pesan Chat Baru' pop-up offset from the bottom-right corner (e.g., `bottom-24 right-6`) to ensure it doesn't cover the chat action button.

5. Bottom Audio Player: In `ReleaseMetadataView.jsx`, convert inline audio to a modern fixed bottom player (Artlist.io/Epidemic Sound inspired). Use full width, blur background (`backdrop-blur-2xl bg-background/85`). Must retain the download button on the right side.
6. Role Nav Preview: Update `RoleNavPreview.jsx` to render a simulated visual layout of the sidebar based on configured permissions (read-only mock), instead of just a raw list.
7. Clean up: Remove the 'Import Rate Label' tab (keep 'ubah label rate' functionality intact). Remove the 'Reset Data Bisnis' function from Admin Users.

8. Sound Notifications: Add clear, distinctly audible sound alerts for 1) standard notifications, 2) incoming chat messages, and 3) internal user online status. Ensure sound triggers are robustly tied to these events.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content scrolling under it. Use backdrop-blur with semi-transparent colors (e.g. bg-background/80).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='theme-toggle-btn').
Use modern button styles. Avoid defaults. Enhance with appropriate padding and focus rings.
Ensure color contrast meets accessibility standards. Never place dark gray text on a dark background.
Create depth through layered design elements with proper z-index hierarchy and shadows.
